symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1510: MDL089 on a doc comment above a create that stores no documentation told the user to "Move the doc comment directly above `create json structure …`, after the `create or modify published rest service …`" — moving text written for one element onto a different one.
cause: ValidateDetachedDocComments built the move suggestion from DetachedDocComment.Next for every statement. That is right for a drop/grant standing between a comment and its create (#877), but a create IS the element the comment describes; the next storing statement is a different element.
fix: When the statement head is a create, the warning says MDL cannot store documentation for that element and suggests a `--` comment; the next-statement suggestion stays for drop/grant/revoke/set/alter.
test: mdl/executor TestValidateProgram_DetachedDocCommentOnCreate_Issue1510 (create module role followed by a create entity); control TestValidateProgram_DetachedDocComment keeps the drop suggestion. Revert check: with the create branch disabled the test reports the move-to-next-create suggestion.
insight: A suggestion derived from position ("the next statement that can take it") is only right when the position is the mistake. Ask what the comment was written FOR before telling the user where to put it.
